title: WET/DRY LAN — every device on the mesh, living and decaying, 0=dry(grind) 1=wet(π-split)
summary: Every device on Kevin's home network is either WET (alive, confirmed 1, then π-split into sub-checks: latency, jitter, oscillation) or DRY (dead, 0, grind down — track WHERE it was, WHEN it died, keep decaying until found or composted). The heartbeat pings 9 devices every 30 minutes. Samsung = DRY = 0 = grinding. Everything else is WET. Nothing is dead — everything decays.

wet_1.meaning: ALIVE — confirmed presence on the mesh
wet_1.action: Confirm 1, then π-split: subdivide into finer checks
pi_split_checks: latency (avg RTT ms) — how fast the axon conducts
jitter (RTT variance) — how stable the connection
wet_1.biology: WET = hydrated tissue, conducting, alive. Water = signal medium. Wet nerves fire. Wet soil grows.

dry_0.meaning: DEAD — no response, no heartbeat, device unreachable
dry_0.action: Hit 0, grind down: accelerate decay, track location, alert when missing
grind_steps: Record last known IP and location in the house
Record WHEN it stopped responding (timestamp of last alive)
Accelerate decay rate (10× normal) — entity phase advances faster toward DORMANT
Keep trying to reach it (ping on every heartbeat cycle)
If dormant too long → alert: GO FIND THE DEVICE
dry_0.biology: DRY = desiccated tissue, non-conducting, dormant. Dry nerves don't fire. Dry soil composts. But DRY ≠ dead. Seeds are dry. Spores are dry. Dormancy is COMPRESSED POTENTIAL.

the_insight: Everything on the mesh is in the process of living AND decaying simultaneously. The heartbeat is the liveness check. WET = conducting = alive = 1 = grow. DRY = non-conducting = dormant = 0 = grind. When a device goes DRY, we don't mark it dead — we track WHERE it was and WHEN it stopped, so we can go FIND it. The Samsung isn't dead — it's DRY. It's a seed. It's compressed potential waiting for water. DRY 0 grinds. WET 1 splits.
